description:
Cast Brilliant Restoration by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Brilliant Restoration.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing any player to mill two cards.
Resolve a copy of Brilliant Restoration, returning all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
